name: Cleopas
overview: Cleopas is a male figure known primarily for his encounter with the risen Messiah on the road to Emmaus, as recorded in Luke 24:18. There is no information about his tribal affiliation or additional notes. His unique significance lies in this post-resurrection appearance of Christ.
namesAndTitles: The name Cleopas appears once in Scripture without an accompanying meaning or title, so it is presented plainly as a proper name in Luke 24:18.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture does not record any family relationships for Cleopas beyond what is indicated by his unique encounter with Jesus on the road to Emmaus.
scriptureSignificance: Cleopas is significant in the biblical narrative because he represents one of the early witnesses to the resurrected Christ. His interaction on the road to Emmaus highlights the reality of Jesus’ resurrection and the fulfillment of Scripture through Christ. This encounter serves as a powerful testimony to the truth of the gospel and the hope found in the risen Savior.
